# Render

`cinnabar:extension/render@0.1.0`

Local custom rendering: sandboxed WGSL post-process passes and bounded world-space primitives.

**Grants:** `render` or `world_draw` for primitives; `render` or `render_post` for post passes; `render_depth` additionally for scene depth.

Imported type `vector3`: [`vector3`](gameplay.md#type-vector3).

## Functions

<a id="register-pass"></a>

### `register-pass`

```wit
register-pass: func(spec: pass-spec) -> result<_, string>;
```

Validates a pass; passes run after the scene and before the HUD, by order then name.

Types: [`pass-spec`](render.md#type-pass-spec).

<a id="remove-pass"></a>

### `remove-pass`

```wit
remove-pass: func(name: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Removes this mod's named post pass after the callback succeeds.

<a id="update-pass"></a>

### `update-pass`

```wit
update-pass: func(name: string, enabled: bool, params: list<f32>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Retained enable flag and up to 16 floats exposed to the shader as `param(i)`.

<a id="draw"></a>

### `draw`

```wit
draw: func(primitives: primitives) -> result<_, string>;
```

Appends to this callback's primitives; each successful callback replaces the drawn set.

Types: [`primitives`](render.md#type-primitives).

<a id="draw-lines"></a>

### `draw-lines`

```wit
draw-lines: func(lines: list<line>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Appends depth-tested lines with the same authority and shared ribbon budget.

Types: [`line`](render.md#type-line).
